name: Clay
description: Dug from clay deposits. A kiln bakes it into bricks.

name: Log
description: Cut from the forest. Burned as fuel, or sawn into planks.

name: Brick
description: Baked clay. The base of every building.

name: Plank
description: Sawn wood. Cottages need it for floors and roofs.

name: Stone
description: Cut from rock by a Quarry. Wells and towers need it.

name: Wheat
description: Grown in fields. Milled into flour, or composted.

name: Flour
description: Milled wheat. Bakeries make bread from it.

name: Bread
description: Baked at a bakery. Stock it at a market stall.

name: Compost
description: Rotted wheat straw. Brings tired soil back to life.
